name: chmod
summary: Change file mode bits and permissions.
description: Change the access permissions of each FILE according to MODE, using symbolic or octal notation.

options.description: Use the mode of RFILE instead of MODE.

examples.title: Add execute permission for the owner
examples.explanation: Allows the file owner to execute the deployment script.

examples.title: Set a private key to owner-read only
examples.explanation: Restricts the key to its owner, as SSH expects.

examples.title: Make a project tree readable and traversable
examples.explanation: Adds owner write access and read/traverse access for other users.

useCases: Applying permissions to a project tree
warnings: permission changes take effect immediately; recursive modes (chmod -R) applied to the wrong path can expose or lock system files.
